Good to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

What time is check-in and check-out?

Check-in begins at 3:00 PM and check-out is by 12:00 PM. Early check-in and late check-out can be arranged as a special request, subject to availability.

Is airport transfer available?

Yes. Complimentary airport transfer can be arranged for guests staying in the Presidential Suite, and is available at a nominal charge for all other rooms — simply select it as a special request when booking.

Do you offer spa treatments for non-resident guests?

Yes, our Spa & Wellness center welcomes both hotel guests and outside visitors by appointment. We recommend booking at least 24 hours in advance.

Is the infinity pool open to all guests?

The rooftop infinity pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM and is complimentary for all in-house guests. Cabanas can be reserved in advance through the concierge.

What is your cancellation policy?

Reservations can be cancelled free of charge up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours are subject to a one-night charge.
